versions.text: Parachute flares shall be releasable from the pilot compartment and so installed that danger of accidental discharge is reduced toa minimum. The installation shall be demonstrated in flight to eject flares satisfactorily, except in those cases where inspection indicates a ground test will be adequate. If the flares are ejected so that recoil loads are involved, structural] provisions for such loads shall be made.
